title: Solana’s Tokenized Asset Market Grows More Than Sixfold In A Year
summary: TL;DR: Research attributed to Castle Labs puts Solana’s real-world asset market at about $4.3 billion, versus $700 million a year earlier. Ethereum remains substantially larger, but the gap has narrowed sharply. Solana’s next growth story may have less to do with meme coins and more to do with assets that already exist in the traditional financial system. According to a recent Castle Labs assessment of the ecosystem, the value of real-world assets represented on Solana rose from approximately $700 million to $4.3 billion over twelve months. That is more than a sixfold increase in the market’s size, although it should not be confused with a 600% mathematical gain: the increase from those rounded figures is about 514%. The comparison with Ethereum is revealing. The same report put Ethereum’s tokenized asset value at roughly $16.6 billion, against $15.5 billion a year earlier. Ethereum remains almost four times Solana’s size by this measure, but Solana’s total now equals about 26% of Ethereum’s, up from approximately 4.5%. The category includes assets such as tokenized securities, credit and yield-bearing instruments, rather than a single kind of token. The figures can shift as new products are issued, underlying market values move and data providers change how they categorize assets. It is tempting to treat the increase as a direct forecast for SOL’s price, but that leap would be unjustified. Tokenization can grow without every dollar of additional asset value translating neatly into demand for a network’s native token. The more useful conclusion is that Solana is becoming a meaningful venue for financial instruments beyond cryptocurrencies themselves. Whether it can close more of the gap with Ethereum will depend on issuers, liquidity and the quality of the applications built around those assets.
content: Solana’s tokenized real-world asset market has grown more than sixfold over the past year, reaching approximately $4.3 billion compared to $700 million previously, according to Castle Labs research. While Ethereum remains the larger network at roughly $16.6 billion, Solana has significantly narrowed the gap. This growth highlights Solana's expanding role in hosting traditional financial instruments beyond standard cryptocurrencies.
content_ta: Castle Labs ஆராய்ச்சியின்படி, Solana-வின் tokenized நிஜ உலக சொத்து சந்தையானது கடந்த ஆண்டில் ஆறு மடுத்திற்கும் அதிகமாக வளர்ந்து, முந்தைய $700 மில்லியன் என்பதில் இருந்து தோராயமாக $4.3 பில்லியனை எட்டியுள்ளது. Ethereum தோராயமாக $16.6 பில்லியனுடன் பெரிய நெட்வொர்க்காகத் தொடர்ந்தாலும், Solana இடைவெளியை கணிசமாகக் குறைத்துள்ளது. நிலையான கிரிப்டோகரன்சிகளைத் தாண்டி பாரம்பரிய நிதி கருவிகளை வழங்குவதில் Solana-வின் வளர்ந்துவரும் பங்கை இந்த வளர்ச்சி எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.
